title: Zammad: 2 flaws used in attacks; attackers can run their own code
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 38 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched.

category.label: Documents and collaboration
category.why: It holds shared documents and internal pages.
category.doThis: Patch it, or ask your provider whether they have.

summary: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Oct 5, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
